# Unit test fixtures

- `branding-tokens-0.1.0.css`: the token sheet the family reference (Branding) generated from its own `src/foundations/` on 2026-09-23, before the canonical source moved into this package. The package reproduced it byte for byte at token set 0.1.0; `tests/tokens.test.mjs` proves every later set is this sheet with exactly the lines it lists changed (0.2.0: the header, `border-control`, weight 400, the label and the window elevations). Never regenerate it: it is the baseline of the extraction.
- `people.mjs`: an entity source for the picker (people with teams, one disabled), with controllable delay, failure and paging.
- `notices.mjs`: a notification adapter over in-memory items shaped as the product relay of `beyond-notifications/1` answers, with switches for failure, unavailability and unreachable products, and a `shape` switch that answers as Beyond Projects does instead (`sources: [{ product, state }]` and a summary `{ unread, more, sources }` bounded by `bound`).
- `rows.mjs`: request rows for the collection.
- `family.mjs`: `beyond-family/1` descriptors as a product relay answers them: the 0.3.x shape (inside a project, outside one, a person with no organization), the 0.4.0 additions (`annotated` with `here`, organization `url` and `links.manage`; `many` for the search; `member`; `nobody`; in 0.5.0 `leaving`, with Accounts' `/leave`, and `lengthy`, with long names the location cuts), the organizations a product reads from Accounts (`standing`) and a Spanish label set for the family bar.
- `refs.mjs` (since 0.7.0): branches of a repository as Projects lists them, more than `ChoiceMenu.threshold`, for `RefChooser` and a long `ChoiceMenu`'s search.
- `repositories.mjs` (since 0.7.0): repositories a resource picker chooses from, by account (one suspended), as a paged source a test can make fail or stall.
- `operations.mjs`: a long operation for the 0.5.0 components: an environment's preparation as its record says it at a fixed start, with the usual times (median and 90th percentile), a step in progress with a phase and a blocked step with its reason and technical details.
- `controls.mjs`: a scene of every component that draws an icon-only control, in the state that shows it, for the icon-only survey.
- `shelf.mjs`: an in-memory `Storage` for `Preferences`, which can refuse every access as a browser with blocked site data does.
- `diff/` (since 0.11.2): unified patches `Diff` reads: `git.patch` (several files, hunks, context to fold, a section heading), `plain.patch` (without `diff --git`), `moves.patch` (renames, copies, a mode change), `binary.patch` (both binary forms and an empty file), `quoted.patch` (quoted paths with octal UTF-8), `whitespace.patch`, `context.patch` and `malformed.patch`. The CRLF case is made at run time from `git.patch`.
- `code/` (since 0.14.0): one sample per language `Highlighter` reads (`sample.js`, `.ts`, `.json`, `.sh`, `.css`, `.html`, `.md`, `.py`), each with its multi-line constructs (block comments, template literals, triple-quoted strings, fenced code); `tests/highlight.test.mjs` checks that its tokens join back to the text and carry the expected kinds.
- `lanes.mjs` (since 0.27.0): a crew of subagents for `Lanes` (one finished, one failed, two working with one nested, one waiting for the person) started at a fixed local time, with the product's words, and `spoken(node)`, what assistive technology reads of a node.
- `turns.mjs` (since 0.29.0): a conversation's turns for `TurnIndex` (one that needs the person, one that failed and the last running, each with its address), and `place()`, which puts a turn and its opening message on the page at given heights so a test decides which turn is read.
- `types/`: a typed plain DOM consumer (`dom.ts`) and a typed React consumer (`consumer.tsx`), and since 0.10.0 the conversation pieces' consumers (`conversation.ts`, `conversation.tsx`), since 0.11.2 `fixes.ts`, `fixes.tsx`, `diff.ts` and `diff.tsx`, since 0.11.0 the consumers of its parts (`resource.ts`, `resource.tsx`), since 0.11.1 `shared.ts` and `shared.tsx`, since 0.12.0 the rail's (`rail.ts`, `rail.tsx`), since 0.14.0 `round.ts` and `round.tsx`, since 0.15.0 `floating.ts`, `patterns.ts`, `patterns.tsx`, `table.ts`, `table.tsx`, `audit.ts`, `audit.tsx` and `tokens.ts`, since 0.16.0 `wave.ts` and `wave.tsx`, since 0.17.1 `hold.ts` and `hold.tsx`, since 0.27.0 `lanes.ts` and `lanes.tsx`, since 0.28.0 `ellipses.ts`, and since 0.29.0 `turns.ts` and `turns.tsx`, and since 0.34.0 `waits.ts` and `waits.tsx` (a chooser that waits, a held Send's place and React `Form`'s `report`), with their `tsconfig.json`; `npm run types` compiles them and never runs them.
